name: Conveyor grasping (xArm + 5-finger hand)
summary: A five-fingered hand on an xArm (in the physics, with collisions) learns to see objects dropped on a moving conveyor, reach, grasp with real contact forces and place them in a bin

inputs.label: Policies
inputs.help: Camera networks (grasp_see_*.pt) and policies (grasp_reach/grasp/place_*.pt) to carry on from, test or combine; those left on the machine by earlier runs are found by themselves (not in a round, which

inputs.label: Conveyor model
inputs.help: Make the 3D models: a conveyor 3D file (.glb), fitted to the simulated belt and drawn in place of the boxes

outputs.label: Network
outputs.help: grasp_see_<date>.pt (Learn to see) or grasp_<stage>_<date>_<success>.pt with the camera network it used; Combine a round: the combined policy

outputs.label: Learning curve
outputs.help: see.csv, reach.csv, grasp.csv, place.csv, or test.csv (one row per trial)

outputs.label: 3D models
outputs.help: Make the 3D models: xarm_hand.robot.json.gz and belt_objects.robot.json.gz (with the conveyor's 3D file when one is wired in), for the project's assets

params.label: Run on
params.help: auto: the NVIDIA GPU when there is one (MuJoCo Warp), else the CPU. NVIDIA GPU: only workers that have one

params.label: Task in a round
params.help: 0: learns alone. 1, 2, 3...: one of the Learn nodes of a multi-worker round (all start from the policy wired in; task 1 drives the 3D view); a Combine a round node averages them

params.label: Cells learning at once
params.help: Each cell is a belt, an object, the arm with the hand and the camera. On an 8 GB GPU 1024 learn faster than 2048 (CPU: at most 256)

params.label: Training
params.help: Continue carries on from the best policy of this stage (or the stage before)

params.label: Live cell while learning
params.help: Yes: one extra cell plays the policy in real time for the 3D view. It shares the process with the learning and slows it down several times; No: the 3D view replays episodes of the learning cells instead

params.label: Test: drop height (cm)
params.help: How high above the belt the chosen object is let go

params.label: Belt drawn
params.help: Its own materials: the 3D view draws the conveyor's file itself, textures and all (wire it to Conveyor model; needs a 3D view with scene models). Flat colours: baked into the objects model by Make the 3D models.

params.label: Belt texture
params.help: A picture of the project's assets laid on the belt and scrolled with it. Used by Make the 3D models (Flat colours).
